import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        if isinstance(value, (np.floating, np.integer)):
            value = value.item()
        if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": entity,
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(float(value), 2) if metric in ("revenue",) else round(float(value), 1) if metric in ("share", "WoW", "YoY") else float(value),
            "formula": formula
        })

    # ---- TOTALS ----
    total_rev_tw = df['Revenue_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_rev_lw = df['Revenue_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_rev_ly = df['Revenue_LY'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_units_tw = df['Units_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_units_lw = df['Units_LW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_orders_tw = df['Orders_TW'].sum(skipna=True)
    total_orders_lw = df['Orders_LW'].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", round(total_rev_tw, 2), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", round(total_rev_lw, 2), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", round(total_rev_ly, 2), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", float(total_units_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", float(total_units_lw), "sum(Units_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", float(total_orders_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "LW", float(total_orders_lw), "sum(Orders_LW)")

    if total_rev_lw and not np.isnan(total_rev_lw) and total_rev_lw != 0:
        wow_total = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_lw) / total_rev_lw * 100
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", round(wow_total, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")

    if total_rev_ly and not np.isnan(total_rev_ly) and total_rev_ly != 0:
        yoy_total = (total_rev_tw - total_rev_ly) / total_rev_ly * 100
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", round(yoy_total, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    # ---- TOP 3 ENTITIES BY REVENUE_TW ----
    top_rev = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue_TW']).sort_values('Revenue_TW', ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, row in top_rev.iterrows():
        add(row['Entity'], "revenue", "TW", round(row['Revenue_TW'], 2), "Revenue_TW")
        if pd.notna(row.get('Share_Pct', np.nan)):
            add(row['Entity'], "share", "TW", round(row['Share_Pct'], 1),
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- TOP 3 WoW GAINERS / LOSERS ----
    df_wow = df.dropna(subset=['WoW_Pct'])
    gainers = df_wow.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=False).head(3)
    losers = df_wow.sort_values('WoW_Pct', ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, row in gainers.iterrows():
        add(row['Entity'], "revenue", "WoW", round(row['WoW_Pct'], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, row in losers.iterrows():
        add(row['Entity'], "revenue", "WoW", round(row['WoW_Pct'], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- TOP 2 YoY GAINERS / LOSERS ----
    df_yoy = df.dropna(subset=['YoY_Pct'])
    yoy_gainers = df_yoy.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=False).head(2)
    yoy_losers = df_yoy.sort_values('YoY_Pct', ascending=True).head(2)
    for _, row in yoy_gainers.iterrows():
        add(row['Entity'], "revenue", "YoY", round(row['YoY_Pct'], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, row in yoy_losers.iterrows():
        add(row['Entity'], "revenue", "YoY", round(row['YoY_Pct'], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # Limit to 25 facts max
    facts = facts[:25]

    print(json.dumps(facts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
